keyLimits.en: LinkedIn and email automation only, 250 leads enriched/month, 1 sending email per identity, up to 3 identities, 3 team members
Adds calls channel, 400 leads enriched/month, up to 6 active campaigns, unlimited identities, 25 team members, A/B testing
Adds X (Twitter) channel, 1,000 leads enriched/month, unlimited campaigns and team members, HubSpot/Pipedrive sync

cautions.en: Pricing is per identity (per sending account), not a flat account price: cost scales directly with the number of LinkedIn/email identities used.
Pro and Ultimate share the same €120/month per-identity list price; the difference is in included channels and features, not price.
Annual billing gives 2 months free on Pro and Ultimate, not reflected in the monthly figures listed here.

capabilities.en: Multi-channel outbound automation combining LinkedIn, email, and (on higher tiers) calls and X (Twitter) in a single sequence.
Built-in lead enrichment with a monthly quota that scales by plan (250 to 1,000 leads/month).
Multichannel inbox and A/B testing on campaigns from the Pro tier up.
CRM sync (HubSpot, Pipedrive) and CRM enrichment on the top Ultimate tier.

limitations.en: Basic plan is capped at 3 sending identities and does not include the calls or X channels.
No free plan; only a 14-day trial before billing starts.
CRM sync (HubSpot/Pipedrive) requires the top Ultimate tier, not available on Basic or Pro.

reason.en: Direct competitor for LinkedIn + email multi-channel prospecting automation.
Overlaps on LinkedIn automation and lead scraping for similar outbound use cases.

unknowns: Exact annual per-month price after the 2-months-free discount was not calculated on the pricing page.
Agency plan pricing beyond the 6-identity minimum was not disclosed publicly.
